properties.evidence: Its option (d) — ONE GRAPH FOR INTENT, SEPARATE GRAPHS FOR BUILD — is the x-axis, recorded 2026-08-05 and marked in its own words "Not previously considered", together with the counter that still stands: reflow2 has no vocabulary for a design holding only intent and no build. It saw this axis coming and named its blocker; what it did not do is treat it as an AXIS with a sibling.
